subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers reuse the existing internal command and plugin before-reset contracts, or should OpenClaw expose a distinct typed session-reset lifecycle event?
rationale: Both choices affect the durable hook API, ordering around transcript archival, and third-party hook behavior; the repository needs a single supported contract rather than parallel event shapes.

options.title: Extend existing reset contracts
options.body: Make automatic daily and idle rollover invoke the established reset persistence surfaces with an explicit automatic reason, preserving one hook vocabulary.

options.title: Add a distinct session lifecycle event
options.body: Define and document a new typed automatic-reset event if maintainers need semantic separation from user-issued commands.

recommendation.title: Extend existing reset contracts
recommendation.body: Make automatic daily and idle rollover invoke the established reset persistence surfaces with an explicit automatic reason, preserving one hook vocabulary.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant code and the open candidate implementation both center on the hooks/plugins and session-reset boundary.
